observed_behavior: A create or update competitor introduced after the final preimage check is overwritten; apply reports success and writes a Ready receipt.
expected_behavior: Commit-boundary create-only or compare-and-swap semantics return PREIMAGE_DRIFT, preserve competitor bytes, and leave zero receipt and zero partial commit.
impact: Concurrent or external repository state can be lost, violating AC-013, BDD-013 and the retriable transaction guarantee.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: Competitor bytes injected after the final check remain byte-identical and no promotion receipt exists.
steps: Seal one create Candidate and one update Candidate in isolated repositories.
Inject competitor bytes immediately after _assert_operation_preimage_current returns.
Continue apply and inspect the target, result, log and Ready receipt.
reproduction.sample: Before the fix, the two new tests were the only failures in the 16-test governance suite because KnowledgeError was not raised; reviewer probes on Windows and Linux also reported concurrent_bytes_preserved=false and receipt_count=1.

root_cause.summary: apply_candidate separates its final preimage check from an overwriting os.replace call, leaving a check/use gap at the commit boundary.

next_action: Implementation executor uses atomic no-replace ownership transfer for create and update commit, makes rollback conditional on writer-owned bytes, then reruns Windows/Linux focused, full and fresh review.
